name: Nimble
description: Searches, extracts, maps and crawls the live web and runs cited research agents, for AI agents that need real-time web data, via REST API, SDKs, a CLI, and a hosted MCP server.

skills.name: Web Search
skills.description: Runs real-time web search across multiple engines with configurable depth and focus, returning structured results.

skills.name: Page Extract
skills.description: Extracts clean, structured content from any URL, synchronously or as async and batch tasks with status polling.

skills.name: Site Map
skills.description: Discovers the URLs on a website by following links and reading sitemaps, ready for targeted extraction.

skills.name: Site Crawl
skills.description: Crawls multiple pages of a site with path filtering, subdomain control, and progress tracking.

skills.name: Web Search Agents
skills.description: Creates and runs research agents that complete a web research task and return results with per-claim citations.
